label_status: model draft checked by one person; not independent human labels

draft.declared_in: the meta field of every task of the labels file, kept as received

review.basis: Reported by the reviewer. The repository holds no separate export of the review.
review.how_changes_were_checked: The 300 tasks the reviewer sent after the review equal the tasks of the draft file dated 2026-11-27, label by label and reason by reason.

limitations: One person checked labels a model had already written; nobody labeled the pairs without seeing the draft.
There is no second review, so no agreement figure exists for these pairs.
The labels file still declares human_reviewed false; this record is the only trace of the review.
Validation holds no unacceptable pair and test holds one, so these labels cannot measure how a model separates acceptable from unacceptable candidates there.
One triplet can be formed, in train.
